content: प्रचारः .²1 Going forth, ranging, walking about, wandering; शान्तमृगप्रचारम् (काननम्) <ls>Ku. 3. 42</ls>. .²2 Appearance, coming in, manifestation; <ls>U. 1</ls>; <ls>Mu. 1</ls>. .²3 Currency, prevalence, use, being used or applied; विलोक्य तैरप्यधुना प्रचारम् <ls>Trik.</ls> .²4 Conduct, behaviour; <ls>Mb. 12. 171. 15</ls>; <ab>cf.</ab> अध्यक्षप्रचारः (a title of the second book of Arthaśāstra.) .²5 Custom, usage. .²6 A playground, place of exercise. .²7 A pasture-ground, pasturage; गवां प्रचारेष्वासीनम् <ls>Mb. 1. 40. 17</ls>; ग्राम्येच्छया गोप्रचारो भूमी राजवशेन वा <ls>Y. 2. 166</ls>. .²8 A passage, path; योगक्षेमं प्रचारं च न विभाज्यं प्रचक्षते <ls>Ms. 9. 219</ls>. .²9 Proclamation in public; प्रचारे चापघोषयेत … <ls>Kau. A. 2. 8. 26</ls>. .²10 Movement, activity (संचार); प्रचारं स तु संगृह्य <ls>Rām. 7. 35. 49</ls>.
